strategyReview: The house is still strongest in weekend HL funding reversion and in Polymarket one-touch NO premium fade: the live weekend family is running 423/610 with positive average P&L (and 188/253 shadows), the gated one-touch NO family is 111/180 shadows with +0.96%, and the manual rich-IV/NO shadows remain excellent. The failures are concentrated in non-weekend funding fade (flat-to-negative), PM proxy-shorts against positive trends, cross-asset BTC/HYPE confirmation fading (36% shadow win rate), and one-touch/no-bias variants still incorrectly written as spot-decline bets instead of contract premium decay bets.

failureClusters.theme: One-touch / no-bias premium signals mis-scored as spot direction
failureClusters.evidence: H-534 won only 8/23 scorable tests and burned 7 unscorable; representative examples show small positive contract P&L counted as losses because the prediction required >2% spot decline. H-532 shows the same pattern: 11/21 scorable with many NO contracts moving favorably while the spot-decline exam failed.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author these as contract P&L theses: predict NO/YES premium decay over 7d, never a >2% spot move, and keep the above-strike/touch_direction gate.

failureClusters.theme: Fixed -10 funding thresholds fire on noise
failureClusters.evidence: CBRS H-539 is 15/32 (47%), AAPL H-537 is 13/25 (52%), MU H-535 is 8/20 (40%). Loss examples include CBRS -6.2% -> -33.6%, AAPL 5.5% -> 0.6%, and MU 5.5% -> -28.6%: the signal triggers when funding is only mildly negative or still collapsing.
failureClusters.recommendation: Replace unconditional < -10 triggers with low-tail percentile and an upward 24h change to isolate genuine extreme/reversal conditions.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion has only 9/25 (36%) scorable wins. Numerous variants entered long BTC after it was already within 4% of the 7d high, and HYPE risk-on participation marked late strength rather than early confirmation.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not promote the HYPE-confirmed BTC continuation family. Kill or suspend it; if revisited, require a BTC pullback/early confirmation entry rather than trend-echo conditions.

failureClusters.theme: Non-weekend funding fade and PM proxy-shorts bleed
failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG live is 21/42 with -0.49% avg (AMZN and HYPE are 29% and 33% win respectively). PM proxy-short families are worse: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 3/23 (-2.94%), PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 1/18 (-6.19%). Recent resolved BTC proxy-short lost -9.37%.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep funding exposure concentrated in the proven weekend reversion family and avoid PM proxy-shorting BTC/GOLD against positive trend.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: instead of any CBRS funding below -10%, enter only when CBRS funding is in the bottom 15% of its trailing 7-day distribution and has already begun rising over 24h, requiring actual low-tail reversal rather than noise.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot/perp rises >2% within 2 days after deeply negative weekend funding begins normalizing.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-537: replace unconditional AAPL funding < -10 with a low-tail percentile plus upward 24h change and weekend-only filter, so the trade only fires when extreme AAPL funding is genuinely reversing.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL spot moves >2% within 2 days after extreme weekend funding begins normalizing.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-535: require MU funding in the low tail and already rising over 24h to avoid entries where the -10 threshold fires while funding is still collapsing from mildly negative to deeply negative.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU spot moves >2% within 2 days after deeply negative weekend funding begins normalizing.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: re-author the gold one-touch cap-edge signal as a contract premium fade instead of a spot-decline bet. Keep the >=10pt above-strike cap-edge focus, but grade on NO contract P&L over 7d, not spot movement.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / holding NO on qualifying above-strike GOLD one-touch contracts is profitable over 7 days as overpriced touch premium decays or the barrier remains un-hit.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-532: re-author the no-bias adjusted gap rich-tail signal as a contract NO premium decay trade, not a spot-decline trade. Keep the large cap-edge threshold and restrict to above-strike contracts.
newHypotheses.prediction: Holding NO on qualifying above-strike GOLD contracts is profitable over 7 days as the rich NO gap compresses, without requiring a >2% spot decline.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 15/32 scorable tests won, but losing examples show the fixed < -10 threshold fires on CBRS funding that is only mildly negative and can immediately resume its decline (-6.2% -> -33.6%), so the setup is not isolating genuine extreme/reversal conditions.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% is a sufficient extreme/timing trigger for >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 13/25 scorable tests won. The losses are mostly near-normal readings where the threshold fires but funding has not actually reached a tail (e.g. 5.5% -> 0.6%), so the signal is not reliably capturing a reversion setup.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and leads to a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 8/20 scorable tests won. The losing examples include funding moving from 5.5% to -28.6% and 29.1% to 3.4%, showing the threshold is not tight enough to identify a real stressed tail or a reversal of a deeply negative funding regime.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably predicts normalization and a >2% MU spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The family has 9/25 scorable wins. Many entries fired after BTC had already rallied to within 4% of its 7d high, and HYPE risk-on participation acted as a confirmation echo rather than independent timing, leaving long BTC exposed to consolidation or pullback.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI independently confirms durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Only 8/23 scorable tests won and 7 tests were burned unscorable. The winning examples often show positive contract P&L on the NO side, while the spot-decline exam missed, proving the trade is a premium fade, not a short spot call.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: The gold one-touch high-edge NO signal pays via a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days, rather than via contract premium decay.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 11/21 scorable tests won but 5 burned unscorable. Representative outcomes show NO contracts moving favorably in premium terms while the >2% spot decline criterion failed, so the rich-tail gap signal is being graded on the wrong instrument.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

journalEntry: Tonight confirmed the dual focus: continue to preserve and sharpen YES-overpricing/NO premium fade, and stop forcing contract-premium signals through spot-move exams. The worst struggling families are mis-specified: H-534/H-532 need contract P&L re-authoring, while the single-ticker weekend funding shadows need low-tail and reversal filters because fixed -10 thresholds fire too early. I also reviewed cross-asset HYPE/BTC continuation and left it non-promoted: the confirmation arrives too late and the evidence is strongly against the original thesis. No learnable parameter changes were made because the weekend-clustered evidence did not meet the bar and signal-risk changes were not supported by the current payoff shapes.
